{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_0","type":"agent_message","text":"{\"features\":[{\"description\":\"Volume per atom in cubic angstroms; a direct structural measure absent from elemental composition statistics.\",\"name\":\"atomic_volume\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    v = s.get('volume_per_atom_A3')\\n    if v is None or not math.isfinite(v) or v <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    return float(v)\"},{\"description\":\"Composition-averaged covalent sphere volume divided by volume per atom. only bonds with both radii available are considered.\",\"name\":\"nearest_covalent_contact_ratio\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    if n == 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    props = s.get('element_properties', {})\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    radii = [props.get(t.get('element'), {}).get('covalent_radius_A') for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    ratios = [0.0] * n\\n    for b in s.get('neighbors', ()):\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        ri, rj = radii[i], radii[j]\\n        if occ[i] <= 0 or occ[j] <= 0 or d is None or not math.isfinite(d) or d <= 1e-8:\\n            continue\\n        if ri is None or rj is None or not math.isfinite(ri) or not math.isfinite(rj) or ri <= 0 or rj <= 0:\\n            continue\\n        if d < nearest[i]:\\n            nearest[i] = d\\n            ratios[i] = d / (ri + rj)\\n    weight = sum(occ[i] for i in range(n) if math.isfinite(nearest[i]))\\n    return float(sum(occ[i] * ratios[i] for i in range(n) if math.isfinite(nearest[i])) / weight) if weight > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Mean effective first-shell coordination. Neighbor weight is occupancy times exp(1-(distance/site-nearest-distance)^6); central sites are occupancy weighted.\",\"name\":\"soft_first_shell_coordination_mean\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    cn = [0.0] * n\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8 and math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            cn[i] += occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - (d / nearest[i]) ** 6)\\n    weight = sum(occ)\\n    return float(sum(occ[i] * cn[i] for i in range(n)) / weight) if weight > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Occupancy-weighted standard deviation across sites of effective first-shell coordination, measuring coordination heterogeneity.\",\"name\":\"soft_first_shell_coordination_std\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    cn = [0.0] * n\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8 and math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            cn[i] += occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - mean) ** 2 for i in range(n)) / weight)))\"},{\"description\":\"Mean within-site coefficient of variation of bond lengths, using exponentially weighted first shells; distinguishes local bond distortion from differences between sites.\",\"name\":\"local_bond_length_dispersion\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    weights = [0.0] * n\\n    first = [0.0] * n\\n    second = [0.0] * n\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8 and math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            w = occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - mean * mean)\\n            total += occ[i] * math.sqrt(variance) / mean\\n            norm += occ[i]\\n    return float(total / norm) if norm > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Mean squared positive covalent-radius overlap in soft first shells, a dimensionless short-contact strain proxy.\",\"name\":\"covalent_contact_compression\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    props = s.get('element_properties', {})\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    radii = [props.get(t.get('element'), {}).get('covalent_radius_A') for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    total = 0.0\\n    weight = 0.0\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        ri, rj = radii[i], radii[j]\\n        if occ[i] <= 0 or occ[j] <= 0 or d is None or not math.isfinite(d) or d <= 1e-8 or not math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            continue\\n        if ri is None or rj is None or not math.isfinite(ri) or not math.isfinite(rj) or ri <= 0 or rj <= 0:\\n            continue\\n        w = occ[i] * occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - (d / nearest[i]) ** 6)\\n        total += w * max(0.0, 1.0 - d / (ri + rj)) ** 2\\n        weight += w\\n    return float(total / weight) if weight > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Per-atom soft-shell sum of Pauling ionic character divided by bond distance, combining contact multiplicity, polarity and separation.\",\"name\":\"ionic_contact_density\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    props = s.get('element_properties', {})\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    chi = [props.get(t.get('element'), {}).get('eneg') for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    total = 0.0\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        a, c = chi[i], chi[j]\\n        if occ[i] <= 0 or occ[j] <= 0 or d is None or not math.isfinite(d) or d <= 1e-8 or not math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            continue\\n        if a is None or c is None or not math.isfinite(a) or not math.isfinite(c):\\n            continue\\n        w = occ[i] * occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - (d / nearest[i]) ** 6)\\n        total += w * (1.0 - math.exp(-0.25 * (a - c) ** 2)) / d\\n    norm = sum(occ)\\n    return float(0.5 * total / norm) if norm > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Soft-shell mean squared electronegativity difference divided by its random-mixing expectation, isolating chemical ordering from elemental electronegativity variance.\",\"name\":\"electronegativity_contact_order\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    props = s.get('element_properties', {})\\n    vals = []\\n    for e, x in s.get('composition', {}).items():\\n        c = props.get(e, {}).get('eneg')\\n        if x is not None and x > 0 and c is not None and math.isfinite(c):\\n            vals += [(float(x), float(c))]\\n    norm = sum(v[0] for v in vals)\\n    if norm <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    mean = sum(x * c for x, c in vals) / norm\\n    variance = sum(x * (c - mean) ** 2 for x, c in vals) / norm\\n    if variance <= 1e-12:\\n        return 0.0\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    chi = [props.get(t.get('element'), {}).get('eneg') for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    total = 0.0\\n    weight = 0.0\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        a, c = chi[i], chi[j]\\n        if occ[i] <= 0 or occ[j] <= 0 or d is None or not math.isfinite(d) or d <= 1e-8 or not math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            continue\\n        if a is None or c is None or not math.isfinite(a) or not math.isfinite(c):\\n            continue\\n        w = occ[i] * occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - (d / nearest[i]) ** 6)\\n        total += w * (a - c) ** 2\\n        weight += w\\n    return float(total / (2.0 * variance * weight)) if weight > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Soft-shell fraction of unlike-element contacts minus the random-mixing expectation from composition; negative values indicate local segregation.\",\"name\":\"heteroelement_contact_excess\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    xs = [float(x) for x in s.get('composition', {}).values() if x is not None and math.isfinite(x) and x > 0]\\n    norm = sum(xs)\\n    if norm <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    expected = 1.0 - sum((x / norm) ** 2 for x in xs)\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    unlike = 0.0\\n    weight = 0.0\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8 and math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            w = occ[i] * occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - (d / nearest[i]) ** 6)\\n            weight += w\\n            if sites[i]['element'] != sites[j]['element']:\\n                unlike += w\\n    return float(unlike / weight - expected) if weight > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"RMS neutral charge-transfer propensity from atomic electronegativity (IE+EA)/2 and hardness IE-EA, without fitted parameters or oxidation-state assignments.\",\"name\":\"atomic_charge_transfer_rms\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    props = s.get('element_properties', {})\\n    data = {}\\n    for e, x in s.get('composition', {}).items():\\n        p = props.get(e, {})\\n        ion = p.get('first_ionization_energy_eV')\\n        affinity = p.get('electron_affinity_eV')\\n        if x is None or x <= 0 or ion is None or affinity is None:\\n            continue\\n        if not math.isfinite(ion) or not math.isfinite(affinity) or ion - affinity <= 1e-6:\\n            continue\\n        data[e] = (float(x), 0.5 * (ion + affinity), ion - affinity)\\n    denom = sum(v[0] / v[2] for v in data.values())\\n    norm = sum(v[0] for v in data.values())\\n    if denom <= 0 or norm <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    common = sum(v[0] * v[1] / v[2] for v in data.values()) / denom\\n    return float(math.sqrt(sum(v[0] * ((common - v[1]) / v[2]) ** 2 for v in data.values()) / norm))\"},{\"description\":\"Signed charge-ordering index per atom using IE/EA-derived neutral charge propensities and the force-shifted inverse-distance kernel 1/r+r/36-1/3 within 6 angstroms.\",\"name\":\"charge_weighted_radial_order\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    props = s.get('element_properties', {})\\n    data = {}\\n    for e, x in s.get('composition', {}).items():\\n        p = props.get(e, {})\\n        ion = p.get('first_ionization_energy_eV')\\n        affinity = p.get('electron_affinity_eV')\\n        if x is None or x <= 0 or ion is None or affinity is None:\\n            continue\\n        if not math.isfinite(ion) or not math.isfinite(affinity) or ion - affinity <= 1e-6:\\n            continue\\n        data[e] = (float(x), 0.5 * (ion + affinity), ion - affinity)\\n    denom = sum(v[0] / v[2] for v in data.values())\\n    if denom <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    common = sum(v[0] * v[1] / v[2] for v in data.values()) / denom\\n    charges = {e: (common - v[1]) / v[2] for e, v in data.items()}\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    q = [charges.get(t.get('element'), 0.0) for t in sites]\\n    norm = sum(occ)\\n    if norm <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    total = 0.0\\n    for b in s.get('neighbors', ()):\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and 1e-8 < d < 6.0:\\n            total += occ[i] * occ[j] * q[i] * q[j] * (1.0 / d + d / 36.0 - 1.0 / 3.0)\\n    return float(0.5 * total / norm)\"},{\"description\":\"Occupancy-weighted anisotropy of the local second bond-direction moment, ranging from zero for isotropic shells to one for collinear shells.\",\"name\":\"local_bond_direction_anisotropy\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    matrix = s.get('lattice', {}).get('matrix')\\n    if n == 0 or matrix is None:\\n        return 0.0\\n    lattice = np.asarray(matrix, dtype=float)\\n    if lattice.shape != (3, 3) or not np.all(np.isfinite(lattice)):\\n        return 0.0\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    moments = np.zeros((n, 3, 3), dtype=float)\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] <= 0 or occ[j] <= 0 or d is None or not math.isfinite(d) or d <= 1e-8 or not math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            continue\\n        w = occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - (d / nearest[i]) ** 6)\\n        if w < 1e-8:\\n            continue\\n        fi, fj, image = sites[i]['frac_coords'], sites[j]['frac_coords'], b['image']\\n        delta = np.asarray([fj[k] + image[k] - fi[k] for k in range(3)], dtype=float)\\n        vector = np.dot(delta, lattice)\\n        length = float(np.linalg.norm(vector))\\n        if length <= 1e-12 or not math.isfinite(length):\\n            continue\\n        u = vector / length\\n        moments[i] += w * u.reshape(3, 1) * u.reshape(1, 3)\\n    total = 0.0\\n    norm = 0.0\\n    for i in range(n):\\n        trace = float(np.trace(moments[i]))\\n        if trace > 0 and occ[i] > 0:\\n            value = 0.5 * (3.0 * float(np.sum(moments[i] * moments[i])) / (trace * trace) - 1.0)\\n            total += occ[i] * min(1.0, max(0.0, value))\\n            norm += occ[i]\\n    return float(total / norm) if norm > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Mean norm of the normalized third bond-direction moment in soft first shells. It vanishes for inversion-paired shells and detects odd angular order, including tetrahedral environments.\",\"name\":\"local_third_order_angular_moment\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    matrix = s.get('lattice', {}).get('matrix')\\n    if n == 0 or matrix is None:\\n        return 0.0\\n    lattice = np.asarray(matrix, dtype=float)\\n    if lattice.shape != (3, 3) or not np.all(np.isfinite(lattice)):\\n        return 0.0\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    neighbors = s.get('neighbors', ())\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    moments = np.zeros((n, 3, 3, 3), dtype=float)\\n    weights = [0.0] * n\\n    for b in neighbors:\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] <= 0 or occ[j] <= 0 or d is None or not math.isfinite(d) or d <= 1e-8 or not math.isfinite(nearest[i]):\\n            continue\\n        w = occ[j] * math.exp(1.0 - (d / nearest[i]) ** 6)\\n        if w < 1e-8:\\n            continue\\n        fi, fj, image = sites[i]['frac_coords'], sites[j]['frac_coords'], b['image']\\n        delta = np.asarray([fj[k] + image[k] - fi[k] for k in range(3)], dtype=float)\\n        vector = np.dot(delta, lattice)\\n        length = float(np.linalg.norm(vector))\\n        if length <= 1e-12 or not math.isfinite(length):\\n            continue\\n        u = vector / length\\n        moments[i] += w * u.reshape(3, 1, 1) * u.reshape(1, 3, 1) * u.reshape(1, 1, 3)\\n        weights[i] += w\\n    total = 0.0\\n    norm = 0.0\\n    for i in range(n):\\n        if weights[i] > 0 and occ[i] > 0:\\n            value = math.sqrt(max(0.0, float(np.sum(moments[i] * moments[i])))) / weights[i]\\n            total += occ[i] * value\\n            norm += occ[i]\\n    return float(total / norm) if norm > 0 else 0.0\"},{\"description\":\"Coefficient of variation across sites of nearest occupied-neighbor distances, measuring inequivalent local length scales rather than within-shell distortion.\",\"name\":\"nearest_distance_site_heterogeneity\",\"source\":\"def feature(s):\\n    sites = s.get('sites', ())\\n    n = len(sites)\\n    occ = [max(0.0, float(t.get('occupancy', 1.0) or 0.0)) for t in sites]\\n    nearest = [math.inf] * n\\n    for b in s.get('neighbors', ()):\\n        i, j = b['i'], b['j']\\n        d = b.get('distance_A')\\n        if occ[i] > 0 and occ[j] > 0 and d is not None and math.isfinite(d) and d > 1e-8:\\n            nearest[i] = min(nearest[i], d)\\n    norm = sum(occ[i] for i in range(n) if math.isfinite(nearest[i]))\\n    if norm <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    mean = sum(occ[i] * nearest[i] for i in range(n) if math.isfinite(nearest[i])) / norm\\n    if mean <= 0:\\n        return 0.0\\n    variance = sum(occ[i] * (nearest[i] - mean) ** 2 for i in range(n) if math.isfinite(nearest[i])) / norm\\n    return float(math.sqrt(max(0.0, variance)) / mean)\"}]}"}}
